SECTION 1. LEASE

1.1 Lessor leases to Lessee, and Lessee leases from Lessor, the equipment described in Schedule A (the "Equipment") on the terms of this Agreement. This is a lease of personal property only. It is not a sale, and Lessee acquires no ownership interest in the Equipment except as provided in Section 9.

1.2 This Agreement is a non-cancelable lease for the full Lease Term. Lessee's obligation to pay rent is absolute and unconditional and is not subject to any abatement, setoff, defense, or counterclaim.

SECTION 2. RENT AND PAYMENT

2.1 Lessee shall pay Base Monthly Rent of $487.50, plus applicable sales, use, and personal property taxes, in advance on the first day of each month during the Lease Term, beginning November 1, 2026.

2.2 Payments received more than ten (10) days after the due date are subject to a late charge equal to five percent (5%) of the overdue amount or $25.00, whichever is greater.

2.3 Lessee shall pay a returned payment fee of $35.00 for any payment returned for insufficient funds.

Meridian Business Systems, LLC — Lease MBS-EL-88214 — Page 3 of 5

SECTION 3. OVERAGE AND SUPPLIES

3.1 The Base Monthly Rent includes a monthly allowance of 18,000 black-and-white impressions and 2,500 color impressions across all units listed in Schedule A.

3.2 Impressions in excess of the monthly allowance will be billed quarterly in arrears at $0.0092 per black-and-white impression and $0.0710 per color impression.

3.3 Toner, drums, staples, and waste containers are included in the Base Monthly Rent. Paper is not included and is the responsibility of Lessee.

3.4 Meter readings shall be transmitted automatically by the Equipment. If automatic transmission fails, Lessee shall submit meter readings within five (5) business days of Lessor's request.

SECTION 4. DELIVERY, INSTALLATION, AND ACCEPTANCE

4.1 Lessor shall deliver and install the Equipment on or before October 30, 2026. Lessee shall provide adequate electrical service, network connectivity, and clear access for delivery.

4.2 Lessee shall execute a Delivery and Acceptance Certificate within three (3) business days of installation. If Lessee does not deliver a written objection within that period, the Equipment is deemed accepted.

SECTION 5. USE, MAINTENANCE, AND SERVICE

5.1 Lessee shall use the Equipment only for its intended business purpose, in accordance with the manufacturer's operating instructions, and only at the Equipment Location. The Equipment may not be moved without Lessor's prior written consent.

5.2 Lessor shall provide preventive maintenance and repair service during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, excluding holidays, with a target on-site response time of four (4) business hours.

5.3 Service does not include repairs necessitated by misuse, unauthorized modification, use of non-approved consumables, power surges, liquid damage, or relocation performed by anyone other than Lessor.

5.4 Lessee shall not permit any person other than Lessor's authorized technicians to service the Equipment.

Meridian Business Systems, LLC — Lease MBS-EL-88214 — Page 4 of 5

SECTION 6. INSURANCE, RISK OF LOSS, AND TAXES

6.1 Lessee shall bear all risk of loss, theft, damage, or destruction of the Equipment from the date of delivery until the Equipment is returned to Lessor.

6.2 Lessee shall maintain property insurance covering the full replacement value of the Equipment and commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence, naming Lessor as loss payee and additional insured, and shall furnish a certificate of insurance before delivery.

6.3 Lessee shall pay all taxes, assessments, and governmental charges relating to the Equipment or its use. Lessor may pay such amounts and invoice Lessee for reimbursement.

SECTION 7. DEFAULT AND REMEDIES

7.1 Lessee is in default if it fails to pay any amount when due and does not cure within ten (10) days of written notice, breaches any other obligation and does not cure within twenty (20) days of written notice, becomes insolvent, or makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors.

7.2 Upon default, Lessor may declare all remaining rent for the balance of the Lease Term immediately due, may repossess the Equipment without judicial process to the extent permitted by law, and may recover its costs of collection including reasonable attorneys' fees.

SECTION 8. RETURN OF EQUIPMENT

8.1 Upon expiration or termination, Lessee shall, at its expense, return the Equipment to a location designated by Lessor in the same condition as delivered, ordinary wear excepted, properly packed and insured for transit.

8.2 Lessee shall remove or securely erase all data stored on the Equipment's internal storage before return, or may request that Lessor perform a certified data wipe for a fee of $150.00 per unit.

SECTION 9. END OF TERM OPTIONS AND RENEWAL

9.1 Not less than ninety (90) days and not more than one hundred fifty (150) days before October 31, 2030, Lessee shall give Lessor written notice electing one of the following: (a) return the Equipment; (b) purchase the Equipment for its then fair market value; or (c) renew this Agreement for an additional twelve (12) months at the same Base Monthly Rent.

9.2 If Lessee fails to give timely notice, this Agreement automatically renews on a month-to-month basis at the Base Monthly Rent until terminated by either party on sixty (60) days written notice.

SECTION 10. MISCELLANEOUS

10.1 This Agreement, together with Schedule A and any addenda, is the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior proposals and representations.

10.2 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state courts located in Kane County, Illinois.

10.3 Lessor may assign this Agreement and its rights to payment without notice to Lessee. Lessee may not assign this Agreement without Lessor's prior written consent.
